name: Handling Questions After a Presentation
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on handling questions after a presentation -- practice these key phrases out loud:
That's a great question -- let me address that.
I don't have that exact figure on hand, but I'll follow up with it.
To build on your question, we also considered...
Let's take that offline so we don't run over time.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
